def main():

        if ws is None:

    wb.save(out_path)

import sys

def main():
    in_path, out_path = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2]
    wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(in_path)

        if serial is None or serial in seen:
            continue
        seen.add(serial)
        ws.cell(row=r, column=3).value = f"=SUMIF(A:A,A{r},B:B)"

    wb.save(out_path)
    print("done")

if __name__ == "__main__":
